cards.text: Jesus enters Jericho and is passing through. There's a man there named Zacchaeus, a chief tax collector, and he is VERY wealthy. He's trying to see who Jesus is, and friend, he's got the money, he's got the title, and he's got a CROWD standing between him and the view.

cards.question: Zacchaeus can't see Jesus because Jesus has already gone by.

cards.text: Nope, it's that crowd, and Zacchaeus is small in stature. Friend, I'm a cookie stamper who spent YEARS looking up at mixing bowls like they were mountains, so I FEEL this.

cards.question: Zacchaeus is too small to see over the crowd in Jericho. What does he do?

answers.text: Runs ahead and climbs a tree
Pushes his way to the front
Asks the crowd to let him through

cards.text: He runs on ahead and climbs a sycamore tree. A VERY wealthy chief tax collector, hugging a tree trunk like it owes HIM money.

cards.question: Zacchaeus climbs the sycamore tree because Jesus is about to pass that way.

cards.text: Jesus comes to that spot, looks up, calls Zacchaeus by name and tells him to hurry down. Friend, you climb a tree just to get a LOOK, and Jesus looks STRAIGHT UP at YOU, says your NAME, and has PLANS for your day.

cards.question: Jesus tells Zacchaeus to hurry down out of the sycamore tree. What reason does Jesus give?

answers.text: He must stay at his house today
The crowd is about to block the road
He has a message for all of Jericho

cards.question: Zacchaeus hurries down from the tree and welcomes Jesus ___.
When the people see Jesus go to Zacchaeus's house, every one of them is happy about it.
All who saw Jesus go with Zacchaeus begin to grumble. What do they say?

answers.text: He has gone to be the guest of a sinful man
He has gone to be the guest of a Pharisee
He has passed by the rest of Jericho

cards.text: All who saw this are grumbling, but Zacchaeus stands up and tells the Lord he gives a BIG piece of what he owns to the poor. A chief tax collector handing money OUT, friend? I did NOT see that coming.

cards.question: Zacchaeus tells the Lord he gives ___ of his possessions to the poor.

cards.text: And Zacchaeus isn't done. He brings up anyone he MIGHT have cheated, and friend, that's a tax collector reading his OWN receipts out loud.

cards.question: Zacchaeus brings up anyone he might have cheated. What does he tell the Lord he'll do?
Jesus tells Zacchaeus that today ___ has come to this house.

cards.text: Those grumblers had a name for Zacchaeus: a sinful man. Now Jesus gives the reason salvation came to this house, and He calls Zacchaeus something else.

cards.question: Jesus says salvation has come to Zacchaeus's house today. What reason does He give?

answers.text: This man too is a son of Abraham
This man has kept the whole law
This man was first to see Me

cards.text: Then Jesus says what the Son of Man came to do. Friend, I spent years in the back of a junk drawer waiting for somebody to come dig me out, so lean in, because this line hits me right in the apron.

cards.question: Jesus says the Son of Man came to seek and to save the ___.
